law: Northsun is the company and commercial platform (product, API, SDKs, backend). Mnemix survives only as: the Memory Lab / Forgetting Test on mnemix.ai (a free diagnostic from Northsun), frozen legacy technical identifiers, and historical records. Frozen identifiers change only in a dedicated cutover, never a search-replace.
